name: Release mosaic images
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Prepare bundle
        run: make release-bundle
      - name: Ship bundle
        run: bash scripts/push.sh
